programme.title: Casper's Scare School
programme.desc: A Haunting Smell ‐ Casper’s Uncle Stinky has started to stink just that extra bit TOO much. Fatso and Stretch just cannot stand Stinky’s horrible smell for one single minute longer and they hatch a plan. They decide to wait for Stinky to fall asleep and then vacuum up the dreaded stink right out of Stinky. It works! the bad smell goes into the hoover bag but as the uncles start arguing, the bag bursts open and the bad smell escapes! The smell collides with Casper while he’s going through the Dimension Tube to get back to Scare School and now it’s CASPER who’s the stinky one. When Casper starts to stink out the school, everyone’s complaining.. Casper must do everything possible to get rid of the STINK! The Manor has Disappeared ‐ Casper’s uncles are out of town and have left the little ghost to take care of the Manor – Casper invites his best friend Jimmy over for a tour of the haunted manor – Casper even shows Jimmy the clock that controls the Dimension Tube connecting the manor to Scare School. Jimmy can’t resist fiddling with EVERYTHING! – and as Jimmy pulls the wrong chain three times in a row he and the manor are sucked into the tube and shrunken down to the size of a hand! Casper has a massive problem on his hands as the little tiny house with the little tiny munchkin inside it causes a huge stir at Scare School and it’s all Casper’s fault! He’s got only hours before his Uncles return to rescue his friend from perpetual munchkin‐sizedness AND return his Uncles manor as they left it!

programme.title: Casper's Scare School
programme.desc: Thatch My Idol ‐ Casper has really had enough of seeing Thatch bully his friends so he sprays him with a perfume he found in his uncles’ magic ointment box. This perfume is supposed to turn the one who wears it into the loveliest person in the world…but actually it just makes OTHERS think you’re great, whilst not actually changing the person it’s been sprayed on! Thatch becomes more unbearable than ever as the kids at Scare School start to treat him like the biggest hero ever, totally putting him on a pedestal of sickening adoration.. Luckily, Casper’s nose is blocked by a cold so he is the only student immune to the perfume’s spell! He is also the only one who can fix his mistake! The Monster Catcher ‐ Casper has been given a mysterious compass which belonged to his ancestor Jasper the Jester. The compass leads him to a secret room in Scare School. He takes his friends to this room and the three little monsters soon realize they are actually trapped in a terrible labyrinth! The situation gets worse when some crazy traps suddenly separate the three friends. They must find a way out but they will have to solve Casper’s ancestor’s bizarre set of puzzles first!

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries
programme.desc: On Harper’s first allowance day, the pets accidentally knock Harper’s Piggy Bank over and lose one of her quarters that she was reserving to buy Nicholas an ice cream cone. Now the Dew Drops must scramble to replace it! / When the Dew Drops struggle to help their kids with tasks that are outside their usual fairy-bilities, they decide to swap kids for the day, but ultimately learn they’ re exactly where they need to be because they know their families so well!

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries
programme.desc: Nicholas keeps stuffing oversized objects inside Eden’s fairy home. But when Qwak, the chipmunk, breaks the pulley, the Dews must step in to keep the treat train running.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal

programme.desc: Kelp and Scallop pet-sit Crabby, who acts out until they realize he’s missing home. / Kelp feels like he can’t choose between a celebration on land or under the sea. So he attempts to do both... at the same time!

programme.desc: When Gloria sneaks into the NY Ballet to audition for “Swan Lake” and gets rejected (not for her dancing, but because she’s a hippo), Gloria’s belief in herself is tested.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School
programme.desc: A Haunting Smell ‐ Casper’s Uncle Stinky has started to stink just that extra bit TOO much. Fatso and Stretch just cannot stand Stinky’s horrible smell for one single minute longer and they hatch a plan. They decide to wait for Stinky to fall asleep and then vacuum up the dreaded stink right out of Stinky. It works! the bad smell goes into the hoover bag but as the uncles start arguing, the bag bursts open and the bad smell escapes! The smell collides with Casper while he’s going through the Dimension Tube to get back to Scare School and now it’s CASPER who’s the stinky one. When Casper starts to stink out the school, everyone’s complaining.. Casper must do everything possible to get rid of the STINK! The Manor has Disappeared ‐ Casper’s uncles are out of town and have left the little ghost to take care of the Manor – Casper invites his best friend Jimmy over for a tour of the haunted manor – Casper even shows Jimmy the clock that controls the Dimension Tube connecting the manor to Scare School. Jimmy can’t resist fiddling with EVERYTHING! – and as Jimmy pulls the wrong chain three times in a row he and the manor are sucked into the tube and shrunken down to the size of a hand! Casper has a massive problem on his hands as the little tiny house with the little tiny munchkin inside it causes a huge stir at Scare School and it’s all Casper’s fault! He’s got only hours before his Uncles return to rescue his friend from perpetual munchkin‐sizedness AND return his Uncles manor as they left it!

programme.title: Casper's Scare School
programme.desc: Thatch My Idol ‐ Casper has really had enough of seeing Thatch bully his friends so he sprays him with a perfume he found in his uncles’ magic ointment box. This perfume is supposed to turn the one who wears it into the loveliest person in the world…but actually it just makes OTHERS think you’re great, whilst not actually changing the person it’s been sprayed on! Thatch becomes more unbearable than ever as the kids at Scare School start to treat him like the biggest hero ever, totally putting him on a pedestal of sickening adoration.. Luckily, Casper’s nose is blocked by a cold so he is the only student immune to the perfume’s spell! He is also the only one who can fix his mistake! The Monster Catcher ‐ Casper has been given a mysterious compass which belonged to his ancestor Jasper the Jester. The compass leads him to a secret room in Scare School. He takes his friends to this room and the three little monsters soon realize they are actually trapped in a terrible labyrinth! The situation gets worse when some crazy traps suddenly separate the three friends. They must find a way out but they will have to solve Casper’s ancestor’s bizarre set of puzzles first!

programme.desc: On Harper’s first allowance day, the pets accidentally knock Harper’s Piggy Bank over and lose one of her quarters that she was reserving to buy Nicholas an ice cream cone. programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries
programme.desc: Nicholas keeps stuffing oversized objects inside Eden’s fairy home. programme.title: History's Greatest Mysteries (S7)

programme.title: Visionaries ft. Keanu Reeves
programme.desc: Keanu and Gard travel to Slovenia to meet Igor Akrapovič. Igor’s company is an exhaust engineer known by MotoGP legends. As they learn from Igor, Arch will collaborate with him on a new project.

programme.title: Visionaries ft. Keanu Reeves
programme.desc: Keanu and Gard meet Paige Bradley, a world-famous sculptor who destroyed her own art to create something new. Using fire and imagination, Paige offers insight into creativity and the artistic process.

programme.title: Wild Portugal
programme.desc: Portugal’s coastal waters and the Azores archipelago boast rich ecosystems. Explore the diverse species living in these waters and discover their unique lives in this revealing episode.

programme.title: Secrets Of The Great White Shark
programme.desc: Reptiles, amphibians, insects and fish are found in every corner of our world - and for this special group of animals, life is regulated by the sun.

programme.title: Destination Myanmar
programme.desc: Destination Myanmar will take the audience to some of Myanmar's most beautiful and stunning Asian Heritage wetlands with fishermen paddling one-legged along shallow waters and floating gardens.

programme.title: Fantastic Friends S2
programme.desc: James and Oliver set off on a road trip to Lake Como with Stan Ianevski. Passing through French vineyards and the Swiss Alps, they learn watchmaking, navigate the dangerous Furka Pass, and end with a relaxing boat ride on Lake Como.

programme.title: Fantastic Friends S2
programme.desc: In Patagonia, the twins join Matthew Lewis in Punta Arenas. They hike to Base Las Torres, reminisce about Harry Potter, learn sheep herding and horseback riding with Baqueanos, and spot a wild puma using a night-vision camera.

programme.title: Fantastic Friends S2
programme.desc: James and Oliver Phelps join Alfie Enoch in Belize. They explore Mayan ruins at Lamanai, visit water caves, learn about Mennonite culture, tour San Pedro's street food, fly over the Blue Hole, and dive in the Hol Chan coral reefs.

programme.title: Reframed: Marilyn Monroe
programme.desc: This episode explores the young Norma Jeane. While showing talent and audacity, she turned her back on her difficult childhood and put herself on the radar in Hollywood as ‘Marilyn Monroe’.

programme.title: Reframed: Marilyn Monroe
programme.desc: This episode explores Marilyn’s defiance about posing nude and how it catapults her to stardom.

programme.title: Reframed: Marilyn Monroe
programme.desc: This episode explores Marilyn’s determination to become a serious actress and her departure from Twentieth Century Fox to start her own production company.

programme.title: Ecuador On The Wild Side
programme.desc: Discover world-renowned, well-preserved biotopes and meet iconic endemic species—macaws, hummingbirds, condors, and marine iguanas. Formed millions of years ago, these species now face growing threats from deforestation and climate change.
